steps.what: Read current mathematical literature and critically examine new results or methods
Discuss developments with colleagues and participate in professional conferences

tasks.design: Retain reading, critical appraisal and professional exchange. Literature in {DOCS} supports learning; a generated summary does not replace checking proofs or engaging with colleagues' arguments.
tasks.previous_blocker: Understanding advances requires examining assumptions and reasoning.
tasks.enabler_now: Summary generation does not establish equivalent mathematical understanding in less time.
tasks.still_hard: A new result's validity and relevance may depend on subtle restrictions.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher challenges arguments and connects developments with actual teaching or research questions.
tasks.altitude: Professional learning responsibility and time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Formulate a precise source question about a mathematical development

evidence.claim: Keeping reading and mathematical professional exchange human is an E1 assessment from model knowledge; topic-summary products do not establish a learning-time saving.

assumptions: Boundary is reading and exchange explicitly named in the task, not bibliography formatting, conference booking or an inferred search baseline.
No structured proof-validity or relevance flag is presumed.
Existing literature and meeting facilities remain; no custom tool is proposed.
Zero upkeep because no workflow changes.
unknowns: Mathematical subfield and professional learning practices
research_questions: Which assumptions or proof steps need direct source examination to understand a new result?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0. Reading, appraisal and conference participation retain time; no guessed locating or booking share is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select and obtain textbooks and teaching supplies

steps.what: Select textbooks or supplies and capture exact purchase requirements
Populate the purchase request with selected materials and supply details
Check and submit the materials request through existing purchasing controls
Receive the obtained materials and check the edition or item supplied

tasks.design: Configure exact field copying into a materials request in {PROCUREMENT}. Keep textbook suitability, requirement capture, request checking and receipt checks with the teacher; the system does not choose the book or change its edition.
tasks.previous_blocker: Selected material details may be retyped into a second purchasing form.
tasks.enabler_now: Native requisition functions can reuse exact selected line fields.
tasks.still_hard: Edition, licence, accessibility and delivery timing can affect suitability.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher judges whether the material fits the course and checks that the correct item arrived.
tasks.altitude: Less duplicate request entry, with educational and purchase-selection judgement unchanged.

reach.task: Resolve an edition or licence query before ordering

evidence.claim: Native request population from selected textbook and supply fields is an E1 design from model knowledge; no digest case establishes purchasing savings.

assumptions: Boundary is teacher selection, request preparation and receipt checking, not supplier or purchasing-team fulfilment.

In s1 the teacher produces ISBN or item ID, edition, format/licence, quantity, price reference, supplier, cost centre and verified delivery location. All 65 hours remain for selection and capture. Missing or inconsistent fields require manual request entry and checking.
After s3 existing purchasing staff apply current controls and the supplier delivers materials before s4. Their unchanged work earns no focal saving and no new curation is transferred.
Test native requisitions before code. Allow four focal hours for field-map and exception upkeep beyond routine request and receipt checks; no free structured address or item match is assumed.
unknowns: Native purchasing support and materials format
research_questions: Can exact selected editions and licence details populate requests without manual re-entry?

already_counted.description: Selection, input capture, request check and receipt check

approvals.approved_version: Exact materials request, identifiers, edition/licence, quantity, cost centre and delivery location; changes require another teacher check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R80 gross20 minus4 upkeep =16 net. High assumes a second manual request entry; low covers an existing native requisition flow. Selection and receipt remain counted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collaborate on teaching and research issues

steps.what: Collaborate with colleagues to examine teaching or research issues and agree responses
outputs: agreed next inquiry or teaching action

tasks.design: Retain collaborative reasoning and agreement with colleagues. Existing materials in {DOCS} support the conversation; a generated meeting summary does not replace joint problem solving.
tasks.previous_blocker: The issue and useful response emerge through discussion.
tasks.enabler_now: Drafting tools do not establish equivalent collaboration with less participant time.
tasks.still_hard: Colleagues may disagree about evidence, goals or practical constraints.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher challenges ideas and builds a shared approach.
tasks.altitude: Collaboration responsibility and time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Clarify a shared teaching issue across courses
reach.learn: Course dependencies and collaborative decision practices

evidence.claim: Keeping substantive teaching and research collaboration human is an E1 assessment from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is substantive collaboration, excluding calendar coordination and note publication.
No structured consensus flag or automatic decision is assumed.
Existing documents and meetings remain; no custom tool is proposed.
Zero upkeep because no process changes.
unknowns: Collaboration formats and shared decision scope
research_questions: Which issues require joint reasoning rather than simple document exchange?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0. Joint reasoning remains fully counted; no meeting-administration share is invented.

tasks.short: Advise students on curricula and careers

steps.what: Advise students on academic or vocational curricula and career issues

tasks.design: Keep personal advising and clarification with the teacher. Current programme information in {DOCS} supports the discussion; no system ranks students or decides their educational route.
tasks.previous_blocker: Advice depends on individual goals, constraints and understanding.
tasks.enabler_now: Reference access does not establish less personal advising time.
tasks.still_hard: Uncertain interests and changing circumstances need careful exploration.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher listens, explains trade-offs and recognises when specialist guidance is needed.
tasks.altitude: Student-advising responsibility and time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Frame a student's specialist career-guidance question

evidence.claim: Keeping personal curricular and career advice human is an E1 assessment from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is the advising conversation, not enrolment processing or formal eligibility decisions.
No free structured student-fit score or automated recommendation is assumed.
Existing programme references remain; no custom advice tool is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep because no process changes.
unknowns: Student support needs and referral arrangements
research_questions: Which uncertainties require specialist career or programme advice beyond the teacher's role?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0. Advice and understanding checks retain all time; no hypothetical FAQ preparation is removed.
